description: ela — SessionStart: context injection, one command per part so each stays under Claude Code's 10,000-character cap per hook output (the working preferences in `prefs I/K` parts); its one write is a start line in the session registry (<runtime>/sessions.jsonl). SessionEnd: an end line in that registry; report an uncommitted or unpushed elak, never commit it — knowledge is committed by hand after Evan's confirm. PreToolUse: the write guard — place (nothing under the published directory, nothing in ela/helm from a session started elsewhere, nothing under a remote site's elak, nothing under <elak> outside blueprint/knowledge/map) and content (no tracked file and no commit message may quote what someone said, name a person, or narrate what a session got wrong). UserPromptSubmit: a standalone language tag (zh, chn, cn, 中文) in the owner's message adds context to answer that one message in Chinese; a vault note named by its title, an alias or its file name (matched against <runtime>/vault-index.json, which the vault sync writes) adds one `vault note: <path>` line each, at most five; neither blocks.
